name: p2mr-conformance-pack
boundary: BIP 360 is a Draft and is not activated on mainnet. Passing this pack is conformance evidence, not a security review or a claim of mainnet readiness.

cases.note: Tests P2MR with null or missing script tree

expect.oracle_error: P2MR requires a script tree with at least one leaf

cases.note: Tests P2MR with single leaf script tree
Tests P2MR with two script leaves of different versions. An unknown leaf version should be accepted and the P2MR output constructed successfully.

script_tree.description: just pushes the string 'BIP341' onto the stack

cases.note: Tests P2MR with two script leaves that simulate a simple lightning network contract.  Reference: https://github.com/bitcoin-core/btcdeb/blob/master/doc/tapscript-example-with-tap.md

script_tree.description: Alice takes the money after waiting 1 day
Bob takes the money whenever he wishes to by revealing the preimage_hash

cases.note: Tests P2MR with two script leaves of same version

script_tree.description: pushes the string 'Taproot' onto the stack

cases.note: Tests P2MR with a complex three-leaf script tree structure, demonstrating nested script paths and multiple verification options
Tests another variant of P2MR with three leaves arranged in a different tree structure, showing alternative script path spending options
Ensure P2MR control blocks can be constructed correctly even when duplicate script leaves coexist in the same tree.
deepest leaf at m = 128, the maximum the spec allows
leaf versions must be even; 0xc1 must not be silently coerced
